result.line: UniswapX V3-Dutch filler on Arbitrum: unverified Ownable executor driven by gas-EOA 0x6ce9efdd fills public orders on V3DutchOrderReactor 0xb274d5f4 (mostly tokenized stocks MSTRx/GOOGLx/COINx/AAPLs/AALs vs USDC/USDT via Uni V4); 20 fills in 7d = 2.9/day, 16 distinct swappers; gross spread mean bash.70/fill (sample of 10 of 20 receipts, range bash.00-1.94; coins.llama.fi prices 2026-11-16); gas ~410k gas @ 0.021 gwei = bash.017/call; est net ~/day; 3 other filler addresses win the same reactor (~130 fills/day total, this filler ~2%) so a fresh address quoting is paid too.
